description: This file defines the SuiteLogger class, a PSR-3 compliant logger implementation within the SuiteCRM utility namespace. It includes methods for logging messages at various severity levels and interpolating context into messages.

classes.name: SuiteLogger
classes.description: A PSR-3 compliant logger class that extends AbstractLogger and implements logging methods with level-specific handling.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message at a specified level, interpolating context and routing to the appropriate logger method.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in the message with corresponding context values.
